description: This PHP class 'FormatWithLicenseId' implements 'ValueFormatter' for formatting license entity values by fetching the license name using a license ID through the 'LicenseService'. It is part of the OrangeHRM Maintenance Access Strategy formatting logic.

classes.name: FormatWithLicenseId
classes.description: A class that formats a license value by retrieving its name based on a license ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the license name by license ID if found; otherwise, null.

methods.name: getLicenseService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LicenseService.
